newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India slices GDR market gains.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India slices GDR market gains.

text.p: Losses on the domestic Indian market, reversing recent gains, cut into the global depositary receipt (GDR) market in London.
"The GDRs are following India rather than leading it," said a trader.

The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed down 0.80 points, or 1.28 percent, at 61.59 points, with the premium over the local market at 12.37 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index fell 61.18 points, or 1.94 percent, to 3,099.34.
Expectations that the Reserve Bank of India would cut bank cash reserve ratios failed to lift the market.
"That has been in the air for a long time," said a trader.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 0.46 points, or 0.63 percent, at 73.30, a premium of 26.71 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index gained 1.48 points to a provisional 842.28.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended up 0.46 points, or 0.63 percent, at 73.30 points, a premium of 1.95 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 0.97 points, or 0.01 percent, to 6,626.41.
